breakdown.description: Gamma-centered k-point sampling conflicts with a half-shifted Monkhorst-Pack mesh.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification retained both contradictory instructions: it states 'Use a gamma-centered k-point grid for all Brillouin-zone samplings' but then also specifies 'use an automatic Monkhorst-Pack grid with half-shift enabled (shift flags set to 1 1 1)' and references 'half-shifted' grids multiple times. The ground truth resolves this by removing the half-shift instruction entirely and keeping only the gamma-centered grid. The agent failed to eliminate the contradiction and instead reproduced the original inconsistency.
